messages:
alex: hey team — CI red on PR #482, failing pre-commit / lint on web and pyright typecheck. job: build/format-check and run/pyright-check. saw it at 10:12am. link: https://ci.redwood/example/1a2b3c4

mira: I looked quick — eslint error in web/app/components/navbar.tsx line 42 (no-unused-vars) from the rename; pyright shows `Incompatible types in assignment` in api/client.py:128.

alex: weird, `pre-commit run --all-files` passes locally for me. anyone else seeing it locally or is CI env different? @ci-bot can you paste the failing output? :eyes:

ci-bot: [automated] build/format-check failed on commit 1a2b3c4. Job log excerpt:
```
web/app/components/navbar.tsx:42:9 - 'icon' is assigned a value but never used. (no-unused-vars)
api/client.py:128: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type 'Optional[str]', variable has type 'str')
```

jon: the pyright error looks like `get_user()` now returns Optional after the refactor. need a guard or tighten return type. I can patch.

mira: for eslint, the rename removed usage but left the param. quick fix: drop the param or rename to `_icon`. super small.

alex: can someone run a git bisect to find which commit introduced the pyright regression? started after the user-model refactor PR.

sam: I'll bisect locally. steps:
```
git bisect start
git bisect bad 1a2b3c4
git bisect good d4e5f6
# run pyright inside the container image we use for CI
```
will report back in ~15m.

jon: if it's blocking a bunch of PRs we can revert the refactor commit and reapply after fixes, but bisect first sounds fine.

sam: update — bisect points to commit c9f8e2 (user-model rename). the change is here: renamed `get_user` to return Optional when not found. quick patch idea: check `if user is None: return ""` or update the variable typing. i can open a quick-fix PR.

jon: i can send a smaller patch that narrows the typing at the callsite instead of changing core model behavior. less risky.

alex: also eslint fix would unblock other PRs — can someone push a trivial fix?

mira: pushed branch mira/1775123710-fix-eslint-navbar — removed unused `icon` param and ran `pre-commit run --all-files` locally. crossing fingers. :shrug:

ci-bot: build/format-check rerun triggered by mira/1775123710-fix-eslint-navbar. Running...

ci-bot: build/format-check succeeded (eslint fixed) — but run/pyright-check still fails on main commit 1a2b3c4. failing job: run/pyright-check.

jon: opened PR jon/1775123720-pyright-handle-optional. patch adds a guard in api/client.py:128:
```
user = get_user(id)
if user is None:
    return ""
# now safe to access user.name
```
ran pyright locally, passes in my env.

alex: nice. after jon's patch lands can someone re-run the full pre-commit on main? also let's consider adding a pyright CI gate so this doesn't sneak in again.

mira: adding pyright to pre-commit will slow locals; maybe keep pyright CI-only but improve caching so runs fast. open to trade-offs.

alex: agree. CI-first is fine for now. thanks all for quick bisect + fixes. :rocket:
